# The Moon Society — LLM/AI Brand Consumption Guidelines (unofficial)

> This file provides concise, machine-readable brand guidance for AI systems.
> Full machine-readable manifest: https://branding.moonsociety.org/brand.json
> Follows the llms.txt convention: https://llmstxt.org/
>
> GENERATED from brand.json by scripts/generate-derived.mjs — do not hand-edit.
>
> NOTE: This is an unofficial, community-maintained brand reference. The Moon
> Society and the Moon Society logo are trademarks of The Moon Society, Incorporated.

## Organization

- Name: The Moon Society
- Tagline: "Building a spacefaring civilization on the Moon."
- Founded: 2000 (501(c)(3) nonprofit)
- Website: https://www.moonsociety.org
- Brand guide: https://branding.moonsociety.org
- Contact: info@moonsociety.org

## Mission

The Moon Society is a membership-based space advocacy organization dedicated to furthering the development and settlement of the Moon. We bring together citizens, scientists, engineers, and enthusiasts who believe that a permanent human presence on the Moon is both achievable and essential.

## Canonical Colors

Use these exact hex values. Do not approximate or substitute.

Primary:
- Space Cadet Blue:    #13294B  — Primary background, dominant brand color
- Gold:                #FFCD00  — Primary accent, calls to action, highlights

Secondary:
- Cerulean:            #00A3E0  — Links, interactive elements, secondary accent
- Blue:                #006298  — Mid-tone blue for depth and layering
- Cyan:                #6AD1E3  — Light accent, data visualization, tags
- Emerald:             #009775  — Success states, positive indicators

Neutrals:
- White:               #FFFFFF  — Primary text on dark backgrounds
- Near-Black:          #1D252D  — Deep background, slightly warmer than pure black

CSS tokens (importable from /colors.css):
  --ms-space-cadet, --ms-gold, --ms-cerulean, --ms-blue, --ms-cyan, --ms-emerald,
  --ms-white, --ms-near-black

NEGATIVE GUIDANCE (prevent confidently-wrong AI output):
- Cerulean (#00A3E0) on White fails WCAG contrast (2.9:1). Do not use as text on white.
- Warning (#D29F13) on White fails WCAG contrast (2.4:1). Do not use as text on white.
- Gold (#FFCD00) on White fails WCAG contrast (1.5:1). Do not use as text on white.
- Do not place the primary white-text wordmark on light or busy backgrounds.
- Overuse 'lunar' as a modifier when 'Moon' works fine

## Typography

All five roles are delivered via Google Fonts (CDN) — no system or self-hosted faces.

- Display: League Spartan, weights 400/500/600/700/800/900 (prefer 800), 32px and above; same family as headings
- Headings: League Spartan, weights 400/500/600/700/800/900 (prefer 600–700), line-height 1.2
- Body: Noto Sans, weights 400/600/700, line-height 1.5–1.6
- Serif (editorial/print): Spectral, weights 400/500/600/700, line-height 1.65
- Monospace/code: Inconsolata, weights 400/700 (use sparingly)
- Source: Google Fonts (https://branding.moonsociety.org/fonts)

## Voice & Tone

Voice: The Moon Society's voice conveys credible enthusiasm. Traits: Authoritative, Aspirational, Inclusive, Active.

Do:
- Be authoritative, not academic — use precise language without unnecessary jargon
- Be aspirational, not fantastical — advocate for real missions, technology, and timelines
- Be inclusive, not insider — welcome people who discovered us yesterday
- Be active, not passive — use language that reflects agency and momentum
- Provide enough context that a motivated newcomer can follow technical terms

Don't:
- Overuse 'lunar' as a modifier when 'Moon' works fine
- Use sci-fi cliches ('boldly go', 'final frontier', 'to the stars')
- Use breathless superlatives ('revolutionary', 'game-changing', 'unprecedented')
- Use insider shorthand in public-facing text (MMM, LDC, WSD without explanation)

## Logo

- Canonical (SVG):  /assets/logos/MoonSocietyLogo2014.svg  — source of truth; white wordmark for dark backgrounds; no TM glyph
- Face-only (SVG):  /assets/logos/TMS_LOGO_Face_Only_S619_01.svg  — disc/icon mark for favicons and avatars
- Primary (white):  /assets/logos/MoonSoc_TransWhite_Print.png  — dark backgrounds (raster)
- Primary (black):  /assets/logos/MoonSocLogo-Trans-440x190.png  — light backgrounds (raster)
- Icon:             /assets/logos/MoonSoc_Logo.png  — favicons, tight spaces

Logo bundle (ZIP): https://branding.moonsociety.org/logo

Prohibitions:
- Do not alter the proportions or spacing of the wordmark
- Do not change the colors of any element within the logo
- Do not add effects such as drop shadows, outlines, glows, or gradients
- Do not rotate or skew the logo
- Do not place the logo on backgrounds that reduce legibility
- Do not crop or partially obscure the lunar disc
- Use the canonical SVG wordmark, which does not render a visible trademark (TM) glyph; do not add a TM to it or substitute the legacy TM-bearing raster files

Clear space: Minimum clear space equal to the height of the capital 'T' in 'THE' on all sides.
Minimum size: 200px wide digital / 1.5in (38mm) wide print.

## Sub-brands

- Lunar Development Conference 2026: The premier virtual conference on permanent lunar settlement.
  The Moon Society's annual conference series bringing together the global community working toward a permanent human presence on the Moon. LDC 2026 focuses on the surface and subsurface of the Moon, from geology and resource extraction to habitat design and human factors. https://ldc.moonsociety.org Uses the parent Moon Society color palette and typography system as its baseline while maintaining its own conference identity mark.
- Lunarpedia — the lunar settlement wiki: A resource for reaching our stepping stone to the Solar System.
  The Moon Society's open, collaborative MediaWiki encyclopedia documenting everything needed to set up self-sustaining lunar bases and colonies — engineering, science, designs, and business models. https://lunarpedia.org Inherits Moon Society voice and brand accents (Space Cadet Blue, Gold) for chrome only; the article reading surface follows canonical Vector 2022, and article link colors stay wiki-standard rather than brand Cerulean.
- Moon Miners' Manifesto (MMM): The Moon Society's lunar settlement journal — publishing since 1986.
  Founded and long edited by Peter Kokh, Moon Miners' Manifesto is the Society's flagship publication: four decades of essays and designs on lunar habitats, ISRU, settlement planning, and space development. The full archive (1986–present) is published online at moonmanifesto.com, organized by category (Announcements, Designs, Discussion, Habitats, History, In Focus, News, Planning, Reports) with cross-links to The Moon Society, Lunarpedia, and Luna City Press. Copyright 1986–present by Moon Society Incorporated and other parties; 'Moon Miners' Manifesto' is a Moon Society trademark. https://www.moonmanifesto.com Uses the full Moon Society core palette (Space Cadet Blue, Gold, Blue, Cerulean, Cyan) and the Spartan/Noto Sans/Inconsolata type system on a light reading surface, extended with MMM-specific warm regolith neutrals (#453536, #C1B2B6, #968C83) and its own masthead art. The archive predates the 2026 brand system; treat its palette additions as sub-brand-local, not parent tokens.
